dataset: pms1000_30fs template data, Xiangyu Gao et al.
timing_note: 120 us is used between samples of the odd-chirp (one-TX) slow-time sequence, matching the upstream velocity axis and paper's 0.065 m/s resolution. Do not multiply this value by 2 again.
angle_note: Use TX index 0 and four RXs in source order; assume the half-wavelength ULA convention used upstream. No independent antenna phase calibration or world left/right validation is supplied.
hardware_note: The paper describes AWR1642; the repository processing script mentions AWR1843. This subset is described only as TI 77 GHz 2-TX/4-RX data; the exact board revision is not independently established.
transformation: First frame selected, reshaped, and losslessly cast from complex128 to complex64; no filtering, normalization, FFT, or phase calibration.

stft_sequence.frame_rate_source: Gao et al., arXiv:1912.12566v4, Table I
stft_sequence.timing_note: No per-frame timestamps are supplied. Frame starts are nominal i/30 seconds; STFT windows stay within each frame, using the existing 120 us same-TX interval. No cross-frame phase continuity is assumed.
stft_sequence.transformation: Select TX0/RX0 from each of the 30 original frames, preserve frame boundaries, and cast losslessly to complex64. No FFT, filtering, normalization, or mean removal.
